text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d the b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e s-e-t-t-i-n-g-s u-s-i-n-g the f-a-c-e-s-c-a-n n-a-t-i-v-e a-p-p, which left a l-o-g-o-n t-r-a-c-e in the a-d-m-i-n c-o-n-s-o-l-e, and the d-u-a-l f-a-c-t-o-r b-i-o e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t c-h-e-c-k was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
2) the a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-o-r-t-e-d the s-h-o-t of the v-i-c-t-i-m's f-a-c-e t-a-k-e-n from a p-u-b-l-i-c p-h-o-t-o using i-m-a-g-e-m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-i-o-n t-o-o-l-s, which left a r-a-w p-s-d f-i-l-e in the t-e-m-p d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y, and the m-u-l-t-i-v-i-e-w b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
3) the a-c-t-o-r t-y-p-e-d the v-i-c-t-i-m's p-a-s-s-w-o-r-d from a k-e-y-l-o-g g-r-a-b-b-e-r into the k-e-y-p-a-d on the t-e-r-m-i-n-a-l, which left a k-e-y-s-t-r-o-k-e log in the h-i-d a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-e f-i-e-l-d, and the i-n-p-u-t r-a-t-e a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
4) the a-c-t-o-r p-l-a-c-e-d a r-e-p-l-i-c-a t-a-g in the r-a-c-k s-l-o-t t-o-r-n the m-a-g-n-e-t-i-c s-w-i-t-c-h, which left a p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l s-c-r-a-t-c-h on the m-e-t-a-l s-u-r-f-a-c-e, and the m-e-t-a-l d-e-t-e-c-t-o-r m-a-g-n-e-t-i-c r-e-s-i-s-t-a-n-c-e t-e-s-t was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
5) the a-c-t-o-r r-u-n-n-e-d the s-c-r-i-p-t to c-h-a-n-g-e the u-s-e-r i-d in the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e r-o-w, which left a q-u-e-r-y l-o-g e-n-t-r-y in the a-p-p l-i-t-t-l-e l-a-y-e-r, and the a-u-d-i-t-t-a-i-l r-e-v-i-e-w p-r-o-c-e-s-s was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
